Title: Missed Periods Before 40 - Why Diagnosis Speed Matters

Description:
Ovaries stopping normally before 40 is called primary ovarian insufficiency (POI) - surgery, cancer treatment, and autoimmune conditions are known causes, though many cases have no identified cause.

Diagnosed within 6 months, 45% had normal bone density. Wait 3+ years, and osteoporosis rates triple. Get evaluated early if periods stop or turn irregular for 3+ months before 40.

Missed periods before 40 aren't always just stress 😮

Surgery, cancer treatment, and autoimmune conditions are known causes of primary ovarian insufficiency (POI) - and how fast you get diagnosed changes your bone health odds.

Periods stopped or irregular for 3+ months before 40? Get a hormone blood test.
